_comment: Goal configuration: every operator enabled and thresholds.break 100, so the run only passes with zero surviving mutants. Mutants that provably cannot change behaviour are declared under 'equivalents' with a reason each; PSMutant fails the run if a declaration is killed, matches nothing, or matches more than one mutant.
_sandboxSubtreesComment: src and tests are the PSMutant defaults. schema is read by one unit test (../schema relative to tests/). PSNetRules.ps1 is the CLI entry point at the repository root: the child-process CLI tests resolve it as ../PSNetRules.ps1 from tests/, so it must exist inside the sandbox at the same relative position. It is a file, not a directory; whether PSMutant accepts a file entry here is what the trial run verifies.
